name: Synthetic fix registry benchmark
note: Fifteen realistic, synthetic error/fix pairs. Every query is written the way a developer would type it, not as a copy of the stored error. No real project data is included.

entries.fix: Install the binary wheel with `pip install "psycopg[binary]"`. On Windows, avoid building from source unless PostgreSQL headers and a C compiler are installed.

queries.q: ModuleNotFoundError No module named psycopg2
psycopg2 modülü bulunamadı python
pip install psycopg binary wheel windows

entries.error: docker: Error response from daemon: exec format error
entries.fix: Rebuild the image for the host architecture with `docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t app .`, or publish a multi-arch manifest so ARM hosts pull the right layer.

queries.q: docker exec format error m1 mac
docker imajı arm64 mimarisinde çalışmıyor exec format error
buildx platform linux/amd64 multi arch image

entries.fix: Enable WAL mode, set `PRAGMA busy_timeout = 5000`, and keep a single writer process. Batch metric writes in the parent instead of letting every worker open the database.

queries.q: sqlite3 OperationalError database is locked
veritabanı kilitli database is locked sqlite
sqlite wal busy_timeout multiple workers

entries.error: FATAL: password authentication failed for user "atlas"
entries.fix: Create the role with `CREATE ROLE atlas LOGIN PASSWORD ...`, confirm `pg_hba.conf` uses `scram-sha-256`, and reload PostgreSQL. Test with `psql -U atlas -d atlas` before changing application settings.

queries.q: FATAL password authentication failed for user postgres
postgres şifre doğrulama hatası kullanıcı
pg_hba.conf scram-sha-256 role login

entries.error: java.security.KeyStoreException: Keystore was tampered with, or password was incorrect
entries.fix: Confirm the keystore path, store password, key alias, and key password. A stale CI secret is the usual cause; rotate the secret and rebuild rather than replacing the keystore.

queries.q: Keystore was tampered with or password was incorrect android
android keystore şifresi hatalı imzalama
key alias store password gradle signing

entries.error: Warning: Maximum update depth exceeded. This can happen when a component calls setState inside useEffect, but useEffect either doesn't have a dependency array, or one of the dependencies changes on every render.
entries.fix: Move derived values out of render, remove objects and arrays created inline from dependency arrays, and set state only in response to an event or an external change.

queries.q: Maximum update depth exceeded useEffect setState
react sonsuz döngü maximum update depth
useEffect dependency array causes rerender loop

entries.fix: Upgrade the bundler and its plugins to versions that support the current Node OpenSSL. As a temporary unblock only, run with `NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider`.

queries.q: digital envelope routines unsupported ERR_OSSL_EVP_UNSUPPORTED node
node openssl hatası webpack derleme
NODE_OPTIONS openssl legacy provider

entries.error: fatal: refusing to merge unrelated histories
entries.fix: Merge with `git pull origin main --allow-unrelated-histories`, resolve conflicts deliberately, and commit the merge. Do not force-push over either history.

queries.q: fatal refusing to merge unrelated histories
git ilgisiz geçmiş birleştirme hatası
allow-unrelated-histories pull origin main

entries.error: error TS2307: Cannot find module '@/lib/metrics' or its corresponding type declarations.
entries.fix: Add `baseUrl` and `paths` to `tsconfig.json`, then mirror the same alias in `vite.config.ts` under `resolve.alias`. Restart the TypeScript server after editing the config.

queries.q: TS2307 Cannot find module or its corresponding type declarations
typescript modül bulunamadı yol takma adı
tsconfig paths vite resolve alias @

entries.error: Error: Error acquiring the state lock: ConditionalCheckFailedException: The conditional request failed
entries.fix: Confirm no other apply or plan is running, then run `terraform force-unlock <LOCK_ID>` with the ID printed in the error. Never delete the lock item from the backend by hand.

queries.q: Error acquiring the state lock terraform
terraform state kilidi alınamıyor force-unlock
ConditionalCheckFailedException state lock dynamodb

entries.error: Failed to resolve import "@/components/Chart" from "src/pages/Dashboard.tsx". Does the file exist?
entries.fix: Declare the `@` alias in `vite.config.ts` with `resolve.alias` and in `tsconfig.json` with `paths`, then restart the dev server. Check that the file extension matches the import.

queries.q: Failed to resolve import vite does the file exist
vite import çözümlenemedi alias
resolve.alias vite config typescript paths

entries.error: RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded while calling a Python object
entries.fix: Find the circular reference first with `repr` or a debugger. Break it by excluding one side from `__repr__` with `field(repr=False)`, or return identifiers instead of nested objects.

queries.q: RecursionError maximum recursion depth exceeded python
python özyineleme hatası dataclass repr
dataclass field repr=False circular reference

entries.fix: Declare the minimum permissions in the workflow: `permissions: contents: read` plus the specific scope the job needs, such as `pull-requests: write`. Organization policy can still restrict the token.

queries.q: Resource not accessible by integration github actions
github actions izin hatası resource not accessible
workflow permissions pull-requests write token

entries.error: Access to fetch at 'http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/search' from origin 'http://localhost:5173' has been blocked by CORS policy: No 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin' header is present on the requested resource.
entries.fix: Add `CORSMiddleware` with explicit allowed origins. Use `allow_credentials=True` only with non-wildcard origins, and handle the preflight `OPTIONS` request before authentication.

queries.q: blocked by CORS policy No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header
cors hatası localhost api istek engellendi
FastAPI CORSMiddleware allow_origins credentials

entries.fix: Use JDK 17 for Android Gradle Plugin 8.x. Set `JAVA_HOME` for the build and, when the IDE differs, set `org.gradle.java.home` in `gradle.properties`. Re-sync the project afterwards.

queries.q: Unsupported class file major version 61 android gradle
capacitor android derleme jdk sürümü uyumsuz
org.gradle.java.home JDK 17 AGP
